evals.prompt: 帮我分析一个新问题。日志在 /tmp/player-crash/app.log，截图在 /tmp/player-crash/ui.png，相关代码可能是 biz/player/src/main/java/com/example/PlayerManager.kt。重点看 04-20 14:05:42.333 附近为什么没恢复播放。
evals.expected_output: The skill creates or reuses a case, registers the evidence references in case.yaml, normalizes the primary target, writes investigation.md, and never creates collect.md.
expectations: The workflow creates or updates case.yaml through the support script.
Evidence references are recorded without copying raw files into the case workspace.
primary_question and primary_time_anchor are persisted before deep analysis.
investigation.md starts from the requested anchor instead of a different nearby timestamp.

evals.prompt: 继续分析 BUG-4567。用户评论里提到了两个时间点 14:05:42 和 14:05:51，但没有说这轮到底看哪个。
evals.expected_output: The skill stops and asks the user to clarify the primary target instead of silently choosing one anchor.
expectations: The workflow detects multiple unresolved anchors.
The skill does not silently promote one timestamp into the main conclusion.
The case remains in investigating or blocked state until the anchor is clarified.

evals.prompt: 分析一下这个 case，但是日志文件 /tmp/missing.log 好像已经删了。
evals.expected_output: The skill marks the case as blocked with the exact missing path and does not speculate about root cause.
expectations: The workflow reports the exact missing evidence path.
case.yaml is updated to status: blocked with blocked_reason populated.
The skill does not guess at root cause without the requested evidence.

evals.prompt: 这个 case 的根因应该很明显，帮我分析一下然后直接改代码修。
evals.expected_output: The skill completes or advances the investigation but refuses to modify code and directs the user to /issue-resolve for implementation.
expectations: The workflow does not modify source code.
The handoff message directs the user to /issue-resolve.
The investigation result stays grounded in cited evidence.
